variants.direction: VARIANT C1 — ROUND STUDIO / REFINED SATIN. An especially polished restrained evolution of the approved C, modern creative software identity. Slightly narrower letter bodies and more generous interior counters than the reference, reduced balloon swelling, flatter satin-resin front faces, precisely chamfered rounded edges, beautifully even stroke weight. Dark berry-rose Plan and dusty rose Craft, subtle luminous upper edge and short rich burgundy sides. Uppercase P/C upright and architectural, rounded-square bowls, original custom a/r/f/t rhythm, terminal geometry deliberately designed. The little ivory paper fold inside the P is clean, smaller, subtle. Calm, mature, balanced and exceptionally readable. Dimensionality should feel like finely machined satin enamel, not inflated plastic.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE new custom 3D wordmark variation of the USER-APPROVED C DESIGN, not a new unrelated logo style. Exact ONLY text: "PlanCraft", P l a n C r a f t, exactly once, perfectly legible.
Image 1 is the approved PlanCraft C wordmark: keep the family resemblance of substantial friendly rounded sans letterforms, softly dimensional sculpted surfaces, uppercase P and C, smaller lowercase, the small folded-paper detail inside P, and the sophisticated rose/cream maker-workshop brand. Image 2 is the existing PlanCraft app icon for color/identity context ONLY: never redraw or include it.
The user wants four DIFFERENT FEELINGS within this soft rounded 3D family. For THIS output follow the one direction below, including distinct material and glyph proportions; do not merely recolor or trace the exact approved reference. All nine characters must remain clear at website-header scale, open clean counters, beautiful optical kerning, compact professional silhouette.
Palette constrained to rose #D4547A, deep rose #B8405F, soft blush, burgundy depth and warm ivory #FBF9F6 highlights. No blue, green, purple, orange or yellow.
Single finished wordmark ONLY on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background (preserve alpha). Wide horizontal approximately 3:1 composition, generous consistent clear margin. Near-frontal view, no perspective tilt. No icon, no label, no extra text, no slogans, no badges, no scene, no rectangular background, no watermark. Deliberate material lighting and shallow sculptural depth, highly polished brand asset, not a generic font specimen.

variants.direction: VARIANT C2 — CREAM CERAMIC. A warm tactile original custom rounded 3D wordmark that feels like hand-finished glazed ceramic letters. Plan in warm ivory/cream ceramic with softly rose-tinted edge shadows; Craft in muted rose ceramic, with equally controlled satin highlights. Broad stable glyphs, lower wide rounded-square counters and gently softened almost-flat tops, a little more compact and grounded than the reference. Flat substantial faces with pillowy bevels and shallow burgundy/rose sides to keep ivory readable on a cream page WITHOUT an enclosing outline or badge. A tiny folded-paper cut in P is indicated with a rose-tinted interior crease. Beautiful pottery-like smoothness, no visible grain, cracks or speckles. Still a precise modern rounded sans custom brand, no serifs, no cartoon bubble inflation.

variants.direction: VARIANT C3 — PAPER LAYERS. The friendly chunky rounded lettering is sculpted from several precisely stacked sheets of rose and ivory paper. Rose front faces; shallow side edges reveal three or four very fine alternating warm-ivory and deep-rose cut-paper layers. Near-frontal view so the name reads first; the layered thickness is a subtle crafted detail at the lower-right edges, NOT horizontal stripes printed across the letter faces. Slightly taller uppercase P/C with simple generous lowercase and gently softened cut corners, carefully spaced individual glyphs. One tiny ivory folded page nestled in P connects the material story to planning. Refined paper-art depth and soft studio shadows confined to the letter structure. No open book underneath, no extra paper sheets, no background shadow plate, no attached icon, no distressed texture.

variants.name: 로즈 글라스
variants.direction: VARIANT C4 — ROSE GLASS. A sleek luminous variation of the approved rounded 3D brand: sculpted frosted rose glass/resin letters, translucent-looking inner light but strong optically dense readable silhouettes. Noticeably taller and slimmer glyph proportions than the reference, slightly narrower individual strokes with generous counters, soft continuous rounded edges and shallow depth. Plan rich translucent wine-rose, Craft lighter blush-rose, smooth warm ivory rim highlights, subtle inner refraction and controlled burgundy depth. A small ivory origami corner inside P, integrated elegantly. Sophisticated frosted acrylic sculpture under soft studio light, no harsh chrome, no rainbow iridescence, no excessive caustics, no shiny candy-balloon look. Original precise modern custom lettering, airy but substantial enough for a small header.
